_comment: Custom metal for sphere_reentry.py --material-file / sphere_sweep.py --material-file. DRAMA's material format: curves are [temperature K, value] pairs; a single pair means constant. Al-Li alloy AA2195-class, values and provenance as in the Falcon 9 upper-stage study (density: Wikipedia 2195 / NASA CR-74545; cp, k, latent heat, solidus: MakeItFrom 2195-T8; cp(T) follows the standard aluminium curve anchored at 900 J/kgK; k(T) reuses drama-AA7075's curve shape rescaled to 130 W/mK; emissivity 0.3 = depainted oxidising entry surface, lower bracket). Melting temperature is the SOLIDUS (823 K), the conservative choice; use 933 K (liquidus) for the optimistic bracket.
name: user-AlLi2195
